transit.noLines: There are no active transit lines.
transit.createSuccess: Created a new public transit line.
transit.createdButSuspended: The line was created but is suspended because some consecutive stops are not connected by the underlying network.
transit.routeUpdateSuccess: The line's route has been updated.
transit.routeUpdatedButSuspended: The route was updated but the line is suspended because some consecutive stops are not connected by the underlying network.

pauseReason.routeDisconnected: Suspended: the underlying route between stops is severed.
pauseReason.noUnderlay: Suspended: the running network for this line type is not configured.
pauseReason.trainTooLong: Suspended: the train is longer than the section its stop is on (a station platform, or a street or track section). Reduce the cars per train, or extend that section.

transit.autoPlatformNote: When the line is created, platforms are built automatically at each stop, just outside the rails on both sides (on streets they are safety islands inside the roadway, right next to the rails). Their length follows the train length, so you don't need to lay platforms separately.
transit.needTwoStops: A line needs at least two stops.
transit.deleteDescription: Removes all stops, segments and the line itself. This cannot be undone.
transit.routeSummary: Runs through {{stops}} stops and {{waypoints}} waypoints in order.
transit.vehicleShortage: Not enough vehicles. The target headway cannot be maintained.
transit.fleetShortage: {{count}} train(s) could not be formed due to a vehicle shortage.
transit.freightConsistNote: Total cars include one locomotive. Only wagons carry cargo; a train needs at least two cars.
transit.vehicleModelNote: Only the look of the vehicles changes. Capacity, cost, and speed stay the same. The stripes on the body are painted in the line color.

estimate.title: Projected balance
estimate.placeholder: Place at least two stops to estimate the vehicles needed and the balance.
estimate.note: Per epoch ({{days}} days). Revenue assumes every run fills {{percent}}% of its capacity twice per loop (once each way on a round-trip line) and every ride pays the fare.
estimate.estimatedLeaseNote: No depot has a vehicle price yet, so the price is estimated from a depot's production cost.
estimate.noDepot: No operating depot is connected to this line's network. As is, the line cannot get vehicles and will not run.
estimate.trackOverload: Exceeds track capacity (planned {{load}} trains/day > capacity {{capacity}} trains/day). Lengthen the headway or add tracks.

unavailable.insufficientStops: Place at least two stops to get an estimate.
unavailable.invalidStop: Some stops or waypoints are in places where they cannot be placed, so no estimate is available.
unavailable.noDistance: The distance between stops is zero, so no estimate is available.
unavailable.routeDisconnected: The route between stops is disconnected, so no estimate is available.
unavailable.noUnderlay: The network for this line type is not defined, so no estimate is available.
unavailable.trainTooLong: The train is longer than a section with a stop, so it cannot run. Reduce the cars per train.
